description: Start, stop or restart a deployed agent. Starting needs an active plan or credits left and charges nothing by itself. Stopping does not pause the plan: a wallet plan that is not cancelled still renews every 30 days and starts the agent again, so cancel the plan with manage_agent_billing to stop paying. The result says what happens with this agent's plan. A restart reloads the agent with its current settings. The change finishes in the background: pass wait_seconds, or follow the returned nextAction, to see the result. When a start is refused, the result says what to do next (subscribe, renew, buy credits or finish setup). On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it; other team members can read the agent with get_my_agent and message it.

action.description: start queues a stopped or failed agent, stop shuts it down, restart reloads a running agent.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents or deploy_agent.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the agent to finish starting or stopping (0 to 600, default 0). 45 or less is safe for clients with a 60 second tool timeout; follow nextAction to keep waiting.

name: control_agent

monthly.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left, so it can differ from renewal.

renewal.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

lastActivityAt.description: When the agent's newest message was written, on any channel, scheduled runs included. Left out when it has none.

setupRequired.description: Whether the agent waits for setup. list_my_agents goes by the status (6). get_my_agent also checks each required credential and names what is missing.

amountUsd.description: What the plan costs every 30 days. For a plan that has ended, the agent's monthly price, which is what a renew charges.

atPeriodEnd.description: For an active plan, what happens at periodEndsAt: it renews, it ends, or unknown for a card plan whose renewal is managed in the Wiro dashboard.

title: Start, stop or restart a Wiro agent
